mapper.select: SELECT FROM ink_sp WHERE sp_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ink_sp WHERE sp_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ink_sp (sp_id, sp_secret, name, balance, unit_price, rate_limit, status, description, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{spId}, #{spSecret}, #{name}, #{balance}, #{unitPrice}, #{rateLimit}, #{status}, #{description}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE ink_sp SET sp_id = #{spId}, sp_secret = #{spSecret}, name = #{name}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, rate_limit = #{rateLimit}, status = #{status}, description = #{description}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ink_sp SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM ink_sp WHERE sp_id = #{spId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ink_sp SET balance = balance + #{amount} WHERE sp_id = #{spId}
